t: A time when the best thing to own is sheep
a: يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَكُونَ خَيْرَ مَالِ الْمُسْلِمِ غَنَمٌ يَتْبَعُ بِهَا شَعَفَ الْجِبَالِ وَمَوَاقِعَ الْقَطْرِ، يَفِرُّ بِدِينِهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ
p: Yūshiku an yakūna khayra māli-l-muslimi ghanamun yatbaʿu bihā shaʿafa-l-jibāli wa mawāqiʿa-l-qaṭr, yafirru bi-dīnihi mina-l-fitan
m: It is close to the time when the best property a Muslim has will be sheep, which he follows to the mountain tops and the places where rain falls, fleeing with his religion from the trials.
